Results.Details: SayItClient uses a one-shot flag 'irisReloadUnbound = true'. If options are modified/tampered after the initial client tick, SayItClient will NOT automatically re-unbind the key.

Evidence.Recommendation: Check unbindIrisReloadKey() periodically (e.g. every 20 ticks or when options are reloaded) instead of a one-time boolean guard.
Evidence.Finding: One-shot boolean latch blocks subsequent calls to unbindIrisReloadKey()
